_comment: Declared layering spec the steward maintains. 'order' is high-to-low. The gate runs a free deterministic up-dependency check whenever 'order' + 'layer_of' are present. If 'responsibilities' are also given, it additionally runs the LLM semantic check (misplaced responsibility, e.g. a model doing I/O), constrained to these rules — never open-ended review.
rules: R1: a module may depend only on modules in a lower layer
R2: no module below 'service' may perform I/O (network, disk, email)
R3: 'util' modules must be single-purpose and hold no domain logic
